title: Bean-to-cup coffee machine deals UK: De'Longhi, Sage and Ninja

description: Today's best bean-to-cup coffee machine deals in the UK, from the De'Longhi Magnifica Evo Next at £379 to Sage, with which model to buy.
intro:

- **Best cheap:** De'Longhi La Specialista Arte (manual), £329
- **Best for lattes:** De'Longhi Magnifica Duo, £549.99

Prices were reported on 26 and 27 November 2026 in TechRadar's UK Black Friday coffee roundup and Amazon UK Black Friday coverage. They usually last to Cyber Monday (30 November). For more, see [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).

deals.note: Ninja's fully automatic bean-to-cup. A strong alternative to De'Longhi at a similar price to the Rivelia.

body:
## Bean-to-cup or espresso machine with a grinder?

A **bean-to-cup** machine does everything: grinds the beans, tamps, brews and (on most models) froths the milk at the press of a button. It's the easiest way to get fresh coffee every morning, and the right choice for most households.

An **espresso machine with a built-in grinder**, like the Sage Barista Express or De'Longhi La Specialista, grinds the beans for you but leaves the tamping and milk steaming to you. It takes a week or two to learn, but the coffee is usually better for the money. If the person using it enjoys the ritual, go manual. If they want coffee before they're properly awake, go bean-to-cup.

## What to look for

- **Milk system:** cheaper bean-to-cups have a steam wand you use yourself. Models like the Eletta Explore, and some versions of the Magnifica, have an automatic milk carafe, which is much easier for lattes and cappuccinos.
- **Cleaning:** look for a removable brew unit (De'Longhi) and an automatic milk-pipe rinse. Every bean-to-cup needs regular descaling; a water filter cuts how often.
- **Size:** measure under your wall cupboards. Most bean-to-cups need you to lift the lid to fill the beans.
- **Cold drinks:** the Eletta Explore and Sage Touch Impress with Cold Brew make cold drinks. Skip it if you'd never use it.

## Which models are worth it?

For most people, the **Magnifica Evo Next at £379** is the sweet spot. It makes good espresso and americanos, and the LatteCrema versions handle lattes at a touch. Spending more mainly buys more one-touch recipes, a nicer screen and hot-and-cold milk.

The **Magnifica Duo (£549.99)** and **Rivelia (£599)** are good upgrades if two of you drink different coffee: the Rivelia's swappable bean hoppers are handy for a decaf. The **Eletta Explore (£749.99)** and **Eletta Ultra (£949.99)** are for heavy milk-drink households.

If you're choosing a manual machine with a grinder, the **Sage Barista Pro at £550** is the better buy over the Barista Express at £499: it heats in seconds rather than a minute and is easier to dial in.

## What's a good price?

On Amazon this Black Friday: under £400 for a Magnifica Evo or Evo Next, under £550 for a Barista Express or Magnifica Duo, and under £600 for the Barista Pro or Rivelia. Prices on these machines move a lot between sales, so anything close to these figures is worth taking.

## Running costs

A bag of whole beans makes coffee for far less than pods or a coffee shop. Allow for descaler, a water filter and the odd milk-system cleaner. If you buy beans on Amazon regularly, Subscribe & Save cuts the price further, and a [free Prime trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) gets you free delivery on the machine and covers the rest of Black Friday Week.

For pod machines, Nespresso and the Rocket Espresso range, see our [coffee machine Black Friday deals](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/). Buying for someone else? Try [gifts for coffee lovers](/guides/gifts-for-coffee-lovers-uk/), or our [Rocket Espresso review](/guides/rocket-espresso-machine-review/) if you're after a serious espresso machine.

## Bean-to-cup coffee machine FAQs

### What is the best bean-to-cup coffee machine for the money?

The De'Longhi Magnifica Evo Next at £379 on Amazon this Black Friday. It makes espresso and americano from fresh beans at the touch of a button, and milky drinks on versions with the milk carafe.

### Is a bean-to-cup coffee machine worth it?

If you drink two or more coffees a day, usually yes: beans cost much less per cup than pods or coffee-shop drinks, so the machine pays for itself over time.

### De'Longhi or Sage: which is better?

De'Longhi is better if you want fully automatic coffee at the press of a button. Sage is better if you want to make espresso by hand and get closer to café quality.

### How often do you need to descale a bean-to-cup machine?

The machine tells you, usually every one to three months depending on how hard your water is. A water filter makes it less often.

### Will bean-to-cup machines be cheaper on Cyber Monday?

Unlikely. Most Black Friday prices run unchanged to Cyber Monday, 30 November, and some sell out before then.
